_status: Research calendar for BSE SENSEX index options. Weekly expiries are Fridays (BSE Sensex weeklies); holiday shifts use the same previous-trading-day rule as Nifty. Monthly = last Friday. NOT a full BSE circular dump — used for research backtests only.
holiday_rule: If the nominal Friday is not a trading day, the expiry is the PREVIOUS trading day (same shift rule as NSE index options).

rules.applies_to: weekly: Friday of the week; monthly: last Friday of the month
rules.source: BSE Sensex weekly options expire on Friday (market practice / Upstox Sensex contract list). Confirmed by near-term BSE.json.gz CE/PE expiries (e.g. 2026-11-26, 2026-12-03). Holiday shift not independently circular-cited — uses NSE holiday list as a shared market holiday proxy.
